claim: since the 2011 vintage, when the winery became the first in the United States to do it
because: Ridge's own history says it began ingredient labels with the 2011 vintage and calls itself only 'one of the first California wineries' to do so. Paul Draper writes there that in 2008 a Santa Cruz Mountains neighbour had already put out wines with ingredients listed on the label, with federal approval. That neighbour was Bonny Doon (Randall Grahm), which disclosed winemaking inputs from about 2008-2009. Ridge was therefore not first in the United States.
fix: since the 2011 vintage, making it one of the first wineries in California to list every ingredient on all its labels
